title: Type AdDraft — PPC pack (Google/Meta PAUSED); not a Post
description:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress. Publicist accepted.

## Type: AdDraft

**PPC is not a Post.** Pack a Google Ads / Meta campaign **PAUSED**. A human click is what enables spend. That click is the only write that turns money on. Do not auto-post. Do not enable spend from a bot.

## Pack limits (design, not schema)

**Google RSA**

- Headlines: 30 chars × 3–15
- Descriptions: 90 chars × 2–4
- Paths: 15 chars × 2
- Sitelink: 25 + 35 + 35

**Meta** (recommended)

- Primary text 125 / headline 40 / description 25

## vs Post

| | Post | AdDraft |
| --- | --- | --- |
| What | Organic Buffer Post | Paid campaign draft |
| Pack | copy+media+channel+time | RSA/Meta fields, PAUSED |
| Clock | Slot `dueAt` | Slot `dueAt` optional |
| Write | Human click publishes or opens composer | Human click enables spend |

## Out of scope

- No live ad-account writes from this epic
- No auto-enable
- Not a Post / not SharePayload
- Discord is not a channel
